dispositions.match: DIRECTX3 is not the old DX3
dispositions.reason: The callout warned that a look-alike renderer identity exists; that identity is retired and refused at configure time, so the warning is obsolete. Replaced in place by a 'Case matters in CMake, not at run time' callout. The old-name -> FREEDIRECT translation row is kept.

CNA now has a real build-time Content Pipeline that writes XNB and CNB (docs/content-pipeline.html); this page's subject is XNB loading and interoperability, so the h1 is 'XNB Loading & Interoperability'. The page keeps its URL, every anchor and its depth.

dispositions.match: Inspect the Experimental C API Boundary
dispositions.reason: The tutorial's premise -- inspecting why the alpha.1 C library could not compile -- no longer holds in source; it is rewritten as 'Your First C Program Against the Experimental C API' (ABI 0.29.0). URL, ids and the honest 'not build-verified' callouts are kept.
Task card about a renderer that CNA retired; its subject no longer exists. Replaced by current task cards (cube-face MRT, parity-fixture registration, oracle re-measurement).

dispositions.match: DIRECTX12 scissor, viewport, stencil and blend factor
dispositions.reason: The card claimed DIRECTX12 lacked these four states; at TARGET all four are implemented (OMSetStencilRef, OMSetBlendFactor, RSSetScissorRects, RSSetViewports in DirectX12Renderer.cpp).
The card claimed DIRECTX11 ignored draw offsets; at TARGET it passes startIndex and baseVertex to DrawIndexed (REMED-GFX-020).

dispositions.match: These are vertex formats, not texture formats, in practice.
dispositions.reason: Statement refined: packed/float formats are mainly vertex formats but texture use is doubly gated (profile gate and per-renderer classification), which is what the current callout explains.
No AccelerometerState/GetState exists at TARGET; sensors are instance classes. The section is replaced in place by 'AccelerometerReading members' documenting the real type.
'100% functionally complete' is unsupported (StorageDevice::DeviceChanged is never raised, web has no persistence); the callout keeps its slot with the verified status.

dispositions.match: Video is effectively native Linux/macOS only today.
dispositions.reason: FFmpeg is now optional (CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO); Video/VideoPlayer types link on every target and throw NotSupportedException at run time without a backend. Callout replaced in place.

dispositions.match: Platform restriction — FFmpeg is NOT available on:
dispositions.reason: The 'fails to link' restriction is obsolete: video units link everywhere; FFmpeg is simply never built for Windows/Emscripten/Android/iOS. Callout replaced in place.
